name: When should I repair a rotted window frame versus replacing the entire window?

mainEntity.name: When should I repair a rotted window frame versus replacing the entire window?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to repair or replace depends on the extent of the rot. Minor, localized rot affecting less than 20-30% of the frame might be repairable. If the rot is widespread, affects structural integrity, or has compromised the window's ability to operate properly, replacement is often the more cost-effective and long-term solution. A professional assessment can help determine the best course of action.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair minor rot (less than 20-30% of the frame); replace if the rot is widespread, affects structural integrity, or impairs function.
